_producer: Producer: GoatLauncher app/src/main/java/.../data/PhoneRoutes.kt (documented in PhoneApps.kt), tested by PhoneRoutesTest. Consumers: android/.../data/LauncherApps.kt and ios/RemoteCore/.../LauncherApps.swift. Changing this means changing both repos.
_about: GET /apps (capped at 2 MiB). A bad item is skipped and the others count; duplicates keep the first; a missing banner is false; a missing color is null. Any 200 means the launcher is there.
